facts.note: Nine o'clock temple bell, watches shown; Ruedi's exact, doctor two minutes ahead, Girard would not take his watch out. Extra colour (every year, Félix's watch) adds no time or whereabouts.
After dinner in the atelier beside the master; at the temple's ten, regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
Sent downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; regulator running and master well.
In the kitchen she compared her watch with Rosa's clock, which was exactly fifteen minutes fast. The 'on purpose' remark repeats the fast claim and adds only habit.
Heard Madame's piano from the kitchen, beginning at 10:48 and stopping at 11:01 by the kitchen clock.
Went straight to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
